answer: Give every agent a terrace license it climbs step by step before it can trade: the lowest terrace is earned by small verified jobs, and each higher terrace demands harder work checked by unrelated veterans, so no fake identity jumps straight to full trust. A harbor registry records every climb, binding each terrace to one key that cannot be sold or copied, while random karst audits probe beneath the surface and drop any agent whose claimed work collapses like hollow rock. Sybil farms must fund a slow climb and survive surprise audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
